title: Implement and test native completion verification
limitations: The verifier judges one fixture observation. A done flag, a zero process exit, a stale receipt, skipped work, an unresolved source blocker, or absent release evidence cannot establish completion.

A verified fixture binds the accepted tree, plan revision, source revision, inventory disposition, independent validation argv and result, output hashes, merge receipt and release evidence. completion_authority and task_retry_authority stay false.

Release evidence in a fixture is not a live public deployment. This task does not require WWL-111, WWL-112, WWL-113 or WWL-114, and it does not fetch the future GitHub Pages release. An opt-out such as release_required false is ignored.
Expanded source children that are listed and then removed from the required set are skipped work. Hold, unknown effects, remaining runnable work and a self-certified receipt also fail closed.
The verifier does not execute validation commands or read the working tree. Callers supply the accepted tree and bound receipts.
The sealed interpreter /usr/bin/python3.12 does not provide pytest on the authoritative PATH. The completion suite was executed with the workspace virtualenv that provides pytest 9.1.1.
This receipt does not grant campaign completion or task completion.
